scenes.label: Natural hero portrait

scenes.label: Smart-casual portrait

scenes.prompt: a spontaneous travel photograph while walking or pausing at a visually interesting destination, face clearly visible, hands relaxed at the sides or outside the frame, layered depth, no tourist-advertisement staging

scenes.prompt: a warm candid lifestyle moment with a pet resting naturally beside the subject in a comfortable home or neighborhood setting, face clearly visible, gentle interaction, hands unobstructed, anatomically correct animal

scenes.label: Full-body style photo
scenes.prompt: a clean full-body street-style photograph, understated coordinated outfit, relaxed stance, realistic proportions and shoes, subtle urban background

scenes.prompt: a natural social photograph while conversing with friends at a local restaurant between courses, face clearly visible, hands relaxed below the frame, food and tableware remain background details, authentic ambient light
